# NeoHub Coworking Space

> Premium coworking centres in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow — private cabins, dedicated workstations, hot desks, and conference rooms for startups and growing teams.

NeoHub operates three hubs in Vibhuti Khand / Gomti Nagar and serves professionals across Lucknow, including Hazratganj, Aliganj, and Indira Nagar.

## Primary contact
- Website: https://neohubspaces.in
- Email: contact@neohubspaces.in
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70004 81286

## Locations
- Bhavya Corporate Tower (primary): 4th Floor, Vijaipur Colony, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010 — +91 70004 81286 (open 24 hours)
- Cyber Heights: 2nd Floor, Levana Cyber Heights, TC-212, opposite Indira Gandhi Pratishthan, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010 — +91 70004 81286
- Experion: 6th Floor, 611, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar 226010 — +91 70004 81286 (9 am–10 pm)

## Pricing (indicative, + GST)
- Workstation: from ₹5,500/month (Cyber Heights / Bhavya); ₹6,500/month (Experion)
- Private cabin: from ₹20,000/month (Cyber Heights / Bhavya); ₹25,000/month (Experion)
- Conference booking: from ₹500/hour

Confirm current availability and rates when booking a tour.
